title: Billboard Graphic
text:
library(tidyverse)


billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  filter(artist %in% c("3 Doors Down", "Aaliyah", "N'Sync", "Macy Gray"))

ggplot(billboard_long, aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track, group = track)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(100, 1)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard chart climb",
    subtitle = "Selected tracks and their rank over time",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Rank",
    color = "Track",
    caption = "Data: tidyr::billboard"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#4c566a"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
